assay_run.method: Aggregate comparison of the five selected group-level tissue extracts. ACQUITY UPLC HSS T3 chromatography; ESI positive and negative modes; DDA over m/z 70–1050. Metabolomics-specific preparation-to-file, replicate and harvest mappings are unavailable. Pooled analytical QC is separate from target preparations.

sample.biological_model: IL-1β-induced equine cartilage–synovium explant co-culture model
sample.biological_source: Equine cartilage/synovial explants; study used four healthy local-breed donors aged 4–5 years; preparation-to-donor mapping unavailable
sample.sample_material: Methanol/water tissue extract from IL-1β-induced cartilage–synovium co-culture without PRP. Exact tissue composition, pooling and harvest interval of the metabolomics aliquot are unresolved. The general design reports three explant-level wells/group; these are not independent horses and are not mapped to acquisition files.
